title: Security of Preprocessed DTP
summary: The known digit-bias attack covers only unpreprocessed DTP, leaving whether preprocessing withstands strong full-message recovery in the multi-tweak setting unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For the $\mathrm{DTP}$ scheme with its permitted key-dependent preprocessing of plaintext enabled, determine whether a strong full-message-recovery attack exists in the multi-tweak setting or whether the variant can be proved secure against such attacks. The existing digit-bias attack achieves full-message recovery in a multi-tweak setting only for $\mathrm{DTP}$ without preprocessing and does not apply when preprocessing is enabled. The preprocessing has been characterized as sufficient only to deter ``casual attacks'' and as unlikely to be a strong countermeasure, so its protection against strong message recovery remains unresolved.

scope.domain: Cryptanalysis of format-preserving encryption, focusing on attacks against a preprocessed DTP variant.
parameters: DTP with permitted key-dependent plaintext preprocessing enabled, the target scheme variant
Strong full-message recovery, the attack and security criterion
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a strong full-message-recovery attack exists against preprocessed DTP in the multi-tweak setting or the variant can be proved secure against such attacks.
